title: An invoice keeps its term and due date when the term is deactivated
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A Net 30 customer already has an invoice, and you then switch Net 30 off.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30 and has an invoice {Invoice-A} dated Oct 5, 2026, due Nov 4, 2026, showing Terms Net 30.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-01b Customer and {Invoice-A} is the invoice of work order S2-15440.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Open {Invoice-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the toast "Net 30 deactivated" shows.
  • Step 3: it still shows Terms Net 30 (the plain name) and Due date Nov 4, 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R7: “An invoice keeps the term and due date it was created with. Changing the customer's term later, deactivating the term or moving the customer never changes an existing invoice.”
